problem_statement: The event_periodic timeout API must support a bounded number of callback executions. Setting a count with event_periodic_set_count(&event_periodic, n) makes the periodic callback run at most n times and then stop; an unconfigured periodic event after event_periodic_init() keeps running indefinitely. event_periodic_stop() must preserve the remaining count, and a later event_periodic_start() must resume the remaining callbacks rather than start a fresh sequence. Once the configured count has been exhausted, the callback must no longer be invoked, and event_periodic.timer.last must reflect the final interval as if the last callback had elapsed one period.

verification.reason: The problem statement already specifies the public API name and behavior (event_periodic_set_count, bounded executions, unbounded after init), the stop/start count-preservation/resume behavior, and the required timer.last final-update behavior that the hidden tests check. No additional names, exact values, or interface details are missing.
